newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck appoints new board member, female director.
newsitem.headline: Merck appoints new board member, female director.

text.p: German drugs and chemicals group Merck KGaA on Wednesday said Jan Sombroek would join the group's management board in July, replacing Klaus Gruber who will retire.
In a statement Merck said Sombroek, 49, would initially assume responsibility for personnel. He was most recently in charge of pre-clinical research and development.

Merck also said it had appointed Inge Lues to succeed Sombroek as head of pre-clinicial research and development. She will become the first woman appointed as director at the group, which floated its shares in 1995, Merck said.
